svg.text: Stack Exchange Data Workflow — From Official Access to Verified Results
Reusable workflow: community, dates, question IDs, input folders and output locations are configurable.
Account creation or sign-in on that community
Profile → Settings → Access → Data dump access
Displayed snapshot date and archive size
Provenance: source, snapshot date and download date
XML extracted to a configurable dump folder
Parameters: dump folder, site, snapshot date,
question period, question ID(s), output location
Posts.xml + Comments.xml + one or more question IDs
• Validate positive IDs and question post type
• Collect comments attached directly to each question
• Collect every answer and order records chronologically
Thread scope: question + direct question comments + all answers
Posts.xml + Comments.xml + one or more question IDs
• First direct comment — ID, text, creation date
• First answer — ID, body, creation date
• Accepted answer — ID, body, creation date
Unavailable related records produce empty XML elements.
Site + snapshot date + inclusive period + 47-field schema
• Read answers, direct comments and acceptance events
• Calculate one ordered 47-field row per question
• Validate the table and record run metadata
• Execute the generic EDA from the verified TSV
Data dictionary: meaning • source • calculation • reading • empty value
Dates are valid; XML opens; every request is present
Every WARN and run_metadata.json are reviewed
Clean-kernel execution completes without cell errors
Tables, figures and interpretations remain readable
A failed check returns to the inputs or run settings. Complete temporary files protect existing outputs.
One file containing one or several threads
One request element per question; twelve named fields
Empty elements record unavailable related information
C — Verified dataset and executed EDA
Outcome totals, cumulative timeline, distributions, tags,
meaningful correlations, selected cases and interpretations
Questions • answers • answered percentage • users • questions/day • site age
Frequent-tag question counts • source URL • retrieval date
Every result remains linked to its source community, dump snapshot, run parameters, validation evidence and documented field meanings.
